target.name: Element Active — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "State — Pending":
  - heading "State — Pending" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Identifier
  - textbox "Identifier": Pending
  - text: Kind
  - combobox "Kind":
    - option "State" [selected]
    - option "Choice"
    - option "Junction"
    - option "Shallow history (H)"
    - option "Deep history (H*)"
    - option "Fork"
    - option "Join"
    - option "Terminate"
  - text: Stereotype (e.g. <<service>>)
  - textbox "Stereotype (e.g. <<service>>)"
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Behaviour":
    - text: Behaviour Entry action
    - textbox "Entry action"
    - text: Do activity
    - textbox "Do activity"
    - text: Exit action
    - textbox "Exit action"
    - text: "Internal transitions (one per line: trigger [guard] / effect)"
    - 'textbox "Internal transitions (one per line: trigger [guard] / effect)"'
  - group "Sub-states":
    - text: Sub-states
    - button "+ Add sub-state"
    - button "+ Initial state" [disabled]
    - button "+ Final state" [disabled]
  - paragraph: Press Delete to remove. Press F2 to focus the name. Drag to reposition.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
